messages:
Noah: Team sync: were aiming to publish the release announcement next Thursday. Need final changelog, public docs link, a single-line benchmark hook for the blog hero, and the finalized webinar demo script. Also need the deploy/canary timing so we can set embargo and press sends.

Priyanka: I will open the changelog PR tonight with rollout + rollback bullets. Proposed rollout: 10m canary -> 45m staged -> full. Rollback if p95 >8% regression. Waiting on SRE to confirm slot.

Ethan: Draft docs are ready. I need the exact model identifier and one sample request & response to populate snippets and the quickstart. Will publish public URL after changelog merges.

Zoe: Webinar format: 15m product, 30m demo (streaming + tool call), 15m live Q&A. DevRel wants both happy-path and fallback demo scripts (quantized fallback) by Tue EOD. Also need a short list of talking points for the hero bench line.

Harper: Messaging: Keep the hero short and benefits-focused: predictable latency, lower unit cost, safer rollouts. Bench blurb suggestion: "~13% median latency improvement and ~10% lower token cost"  can someone confirm these numbers?

Priyanka: Quick perf blurb: median latency down ~13% on our standard web-chat trace; token unit cost ~10% lower using default batching & cache. Will link perf artifact in the changelog PR. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1003

Noah: Great. @Priyanka please confirm SRE window and paste the deploy link once scheduled. Marketing needs embargo timing for press.

Priyanka: SRE confirmed canary slot at 2026-06-12T15:00:00Z (10m). DeployBot will handle staged cutover. Embargo request: marketing suggested embargo lift 2 hours after full rollout; product OK with that.

DeployBot: Deploy scheduled: release v1.16.1 at 2026-06-12T15:00:00Z (canary 10m, staged 45m). Rollback trigger: p95 regression >8%. Link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/ops/14299

Ethan: I'll publish the public docs page after the changelog PR merges. Draft internal link: https://redwood.docs.internal/drafts/v1.16.1. Please paste the final curl + SDK snippets when available.

Zoe: DevRel will deliver demo scripts Tue 17:00 PT. Will include fallback flows and a short script note that if fallback occurs we switch to the quantized model and note latency/cost tradeoffs in the demo.

Noah: Action list: Priyanka finish changelog + perf link, Ethan publish public docs after merge, Zoe deliver demo scripts, Harper finalize hero copy with bench blurb, Marketing build landing page and lead routing (GDPR consent required). Everyone ack? :thumbsup:

Priyanka: ack

Ethan: ack

Zoe: ack

Harper: ack

Noah: Small schedule tweak: canary pushed +5min; DeployBot updated schedule. Also note: we abort canary and pause press if p95 regression >8% or error rate spikes >1%. Ensure alerts and a comms escalation path.

DeployBot: Updated deploy schedule: canary start 2026-06-12T15:05:00Z.

Noah: Thanks all. I'll draft embargo email and share landing page once live.

Priyanka: Adding watch alerts now and will document rollback steps in the changelog PR.
